title.en: Well-stocked raw food and accessory shop

text.en: Pet owners appreciate the wide selection of raw feeds, natural treats, and pet accessories available at the Belle Isle shop. Reviewers describe the premises as convenient, well organized, and reliably supplied with varied canine nutrition options. Customers value having a local store combining quality food stocks with grooming.

Reviews consistently praise the proprietors for their welcoming attitude and helpful customer service. Clients mention that the team willingly assists with product advice and community animal welfare, including helping with stray dogs. Visitors appreciate the personalized and kind approach shown to both pets and their owners.

Dog owners report positive experiences having their pets groomed at the salon, from giant breeds to chow chows. Reviewers note that groomer Janine handles dogs with patience, ensuring pets feel secure throughout washing and styling appointments. Clients highlight that dogs leave relaxed and beautifully turned out after their visits.

q.en: What products are available at LS RAW Grooming & Accessories?

a.en: The shop offers raw dog feeds, natural treats, and canine accessories alongside professional grooming services.

q.en: Can large and double-coated breeds be groomed at the salon?

a.en: Yes, clients mention successful grooming appointments for large breeds including Giant Schnauzers and Chow Chows.

q.en: How do clients rate the customer service and staff?

a.en: Reviewers describe the owners as friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful with both grooming and dietary advice.

q.en: How are the prices rated by customers?

a.en: Clients describe the shop as reasonably priced with good value on raw food products and accessories.
